# Nextup

> A self-hosted tracker for the TV shows and films you watch. It records which
> episodes you have seen, works out which one is next, says when the next
> episode airs, and says when a film reaches streaming in the UK. It runs on
> your own server and sends nothing anywhere except requests to TMDB.

Nextup is free software published by Lightmorphic Ltd under the GNU General
Public Licence version 3. There is no hosted version, no account to create and
no paid tier. You install it yourself with Docker.

## What it does

- Next up: every tracked show with an aired episode you have not watched, oldest first.
- Ticking off: one episode, a whole season, or everything up to a chosen episode.
- Calendar and Coming soon: when your shows air, over 14 to 180 days.
- Discover: what is arriving, with a tick, question mark and cross on each item. Films are filtered to home releases, not cinema ones.
- Maybe list: shows and films you are curious about, kept out of Next up.
- Films: split into ready to watch, coming to streaming, and seen, with the UK services that carry each one.
- Episode pages: still, synopsis, air date, runtime, guest cast and director.
- Show and film pages: cast with photographs, genres, certificate, who made it, where to watch it.

## What it does not do

- It does not play, stream or download video, and links to no source of it.
- It has one account and one watch history. It is not multi-user.
- It has no notifications, and no import from another tracker.
- It is not hosted for you. You run it or you do not use it.

## Requirements

Docker, and a free TMDB API key entered in the app's own Settings page, where it
is stored encrypted rather than in an environment file.
